description: Orchestrate SDLC workflows: Task (feature/task/story), CR (change request), Cook (ready tasks → implementation)

evals.name: Parse workflow type and route to correct workflow
evals.prompt: Dùng orchestrator để tạo feature mới: 'add user authentication with JWT', tự động.
evals.expected_output: Skill trích xuất workflow='task', description='add user authentication with JWT', flag --auto, route đến references/task-workflow.md.

evals.name: Cook workflow execution with parallel BE+FE TDD
evals.prompt: Dùng orchestrator cook để triển khai các task đã sẵn sàng trên board, tự động.
evals.expected_output: Skill load board, xác định ready tasks, spawn TDD agents (BE+FE) song song, gate-verify mỗi phase, cập nhật board sau completion. Dùng Task tools pipeline tracking.
